maxn = 510
c = [[0] * (maxn) for _ in range(maxn)]
for i in range(maxn):
    c[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        c[i][j] = (c[i - 1][j] + c[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod

# Helper functions
def Arth(x):
    return (x * (x + 1) // 2) % mod

# Initialize arrays
dp_con = [0] * maxn
sum_con = [0] * maxn
dp_con[0] = 1
dp_con[1] = 2
sum_con[0] = 0

        rcon = (rcon * c[i - 1][j]) % mod
        rcon = (rcon * (i + 1)) % mod
        dp_con[i] = (dp_con[i] + rcon * (i + 1)) % mod

        temp1 = (dp_con[j] * sum_con[i - j - 1]) % mod
        temp2 = (sum_con[j] * dp_con[i - j - 1]) % mod
        sum_con[i] = (sum_con[i] + (temp1 + temp2) % mod * c[i - 1][j] * (i + 1)) % mod
        sum_con[i] = (sum_con[i] + rcon * (Arth(j) + Arth(i - 1 - j))) % mod

# Initialize DP arrays
dp = [[0] * (maxn) for _ in range(maxn)]
sum_dp = [[0] * (maxn) for _ in range(maxn)]

                val = (val * c[i + k][k]) % mod
                dp[ni][nj] = (dp[ni][nj] + val) % mod

                temp1 = (dp[i][j] * sum_con[k]) % mod
                temp2 = (sum_dp[i][j] * dp_con[k]) % mod
                sum_dp[ni][nj] = (sum_dp[ni][nj] + (temp1 + temp2) % mod * c[i + k][k]) % mod

# Calculate answer

    val = (sum_dp[m][j] * c[n - (m - 1 + j) + j][j]) % mod
    ans = (ans + val) % mod
